title: Classifier calls (system-classifier)
description: One call per item of systems/unmatched.json: the outside system it proves, or why it is not an outside system; and one entry per system named, with what it is and the words to search the org's code for.

item.description: The item's id in systems/unmatched.json (u1, u2, ...).

system.description: verdict system: the vendor or product as people name it (a known system's name when it is one).

kind.description: verdict system: what kind of system it is.

middleware.description: verdict system: true for an integration platform that carries data on to other systems (Make, Zapier, MuleSoft).

reason.description: The evidence for the call in one sentence: the domain, the description, the publisher.

sources.description: Web pages the call rests on, when it rests on any.

description.description: What the system is, in one short sentence.

searchTerms.description: Words that name the system in Flow and Apex source: its name when that is distinctive, otherwise distinctive words only (never an everyday word such as 'make' or 'box').
